text:
Ellie (EngSec): quick sync — SOC2/ISO checkpoint next Wed. Need a micro-update on KMS/HSM rollout, audit-log pipeline backfill, and evidence owners. Who's got what?

Samir (Eng-Infra): infra owns the KMS provisioning + HSM peering. PR #342 is the terraform change for staging (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342). Deployed to staging yesterday but HSM vendor needs the client cert rotated for prod peering — blocked on vendor ops.

Maya (Eng-Platform): platform owns key rotation automation and the KMS API surface. I've got a canary job in k8s: `rotation-checker` that validates `Encrypt/Decrypt` and rotation windows. Tests scheduled tomorrow AM.

Raj (Eng-Runtime): runtime needs to wire the new key ARNs into the KV cache encryption layer. I put up PR #128 on runtime that reads `REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ARN` from config and falls back to legacy key. Need eng-infra to provide the prod ARN and confirm rotation compatibility. Small change but needs runtime e2e before we sign off.

Tina (Compliance): for evidence we need three items: (1) key lifecycle policy (owner + date), (2) HSM network config + vendor attestation, (3) audit-log retention and access controls. Please call out a single owner for each item and an ETA. Our auditor asked for artifacts by Tue COB.

Samir (Eng-Infra): owners — (1) infra (Samir) for key lifecycle policy, ETA Mon EOD; (2) infra + vendor (ThalesOps) for HSM attestation, vendor ETA uncertain but asking for 72h; (3) audit-log pipeline is on infolog team but infra will surface where logs are landing.

Maya (Eng-Platform): platform will own (3) audit-log access control wiring into the console (RBAC + token scoping). I can produce a short runbook and evidence snippet by Mon noon.

Raj (Eng-Runtime): I can validate the runtime changes by Mon afternoon if infra gives me the staging ARN and the test rotation hook. PR #128 is small:

```
# snippet from runtime config
env:
  - name: REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ARN
    value: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-1234"
```

Ellie (EngSec): blockers summary — vendor cert/attestation and prod KMS ARN. If vendor can't commit within 72h we need fallback: use CloudHSM-managed cluster for prod and capture that decision as evidence. Can infra escalate the vendor SLA?

Samir (Eng-Infra): escalating now to ThalesOps + vendor slack. Filed internal ticket INF-729. If vendor misses SLA, fallback to CloudHSM is viable but will require network changes (VPC peering + NAT). Estimate +3 days for fallback.

Tina (Compliance): acceptable as long as we document decision and timeline. Please add evidence owners to the compliance doc: `/docs/compliance/soc221/evidence-tracker.md` and tag me.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded — infra/pr-342 applied to staging at 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z.

Ellie (EngSec): next actions: (A) Samir escalate vendor + confirm prod ARN by EOD Mon or call fallback; (B) Raj finish runtime PR + request e2e; (C) Maya produce runbook + console evidence by Mon noon; (D) Tina confirm auditor acceptance once we upload artifacts. I'll pull this into the milestone board and assign owners. Ping me when PRs referenced above are ready for review. :thumbsup:

Maya (Eng-Platform): ping @Samir for the ARN — I have a tiny GUI change that blocks the evidence screenshot, will ship once ARN confirmed.

Samir (Eng-Infra): pinged vendor, escalated to SE. Will update infra ticket and drop ARN in #sec-ops when available.

Raj (Eng-Runtime): will request an expedited review from @ellie and @maya once e2e passes.

Tina (Compliance): I'll schedule a 15-min evidence walk-through Tue 10am with the auditor if we have artifacts by Mon EOD.

Ellie (EngSec): thanks all. If any of the owners want the SOC2 playbook snippets, I pushed a templated artifact to the repo: `infra/docs/soc2/key-lifecycle-template.md`. Use that for the evidence write-up.

Samir (Eng-Infra): noted, will use template.

Raj (Eng-Runtime): adding TODO to PR for linking to evidence doc.

Ellie (EngSec): closing loop here — please post updates in this thread so I can snapshot into the milestone before Tue.
